description: This plot illustrates the relationship between Loss and Training Time (s) for two configurations, labeled Vanilla and SepLLM. The x-axis represents Training Time (s) on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 250000 with tick marks at intervals of 50000. The y-axis represents Loss on a linear scale, ranging from 2.40 to 2.75 with tick marks at intervals of 0.05. The Vanilla configuration is represented by a solid purple line with upward-pointing triangle markers. It exhibits a continuous decline, with its first clearly visible marker at approximately 20,000 seconds and a loss of 2.70, decreasing steadily to a final value of 2.50 at a training time of roughly 245,000 seconds. The SepLLM configuration is represented by a solid red line with circular markers. It also shows a continuous decline, starting with a visible marker at approximately 15,000 seconds and a loss of 2.71, and decreasing to a final value of approximately 2.49 at a training time of roughly 235,000 seconds. Additionally, the plot features a horizontal green dashed line at a loss value of 2.50. This line intersects the SepLLM curve at approximately 195,000 seconds and the Vanilla curve at approximately 245,000 seconds, with both intersection points denoted by green star markers. Vertical green dashed lines extend downward from these two points, and a horizontal green double-headed arrow labeled "1.26×" spans the gap between them.
